step1_analysis.circuit_type: MOS Current Mode Logic (MCML) Differential Buffer / Logic Gate
step1_analysis.description: A high-speed differential logic gate using current steering. It consists of an NMOS differential pair (XM1, XM3), grounded-gate PMOS triode loads (XM2, XM6), and an NMOS tail current source (XM7). Transistors XM4 and XM5 appear to be feedback or dummy devices, though they are biased OFF in this specific netlist configuration.

paper_reference.title: 0.18-m CMOS 10-Gb/s Multiplexer/Demultiplexer ICs Using Current Mode Logic with Tolerance to Threshold Voltage Fluctuation

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the MCML gate.

sky130_expected.calculation: I_tail * VDD. With Vbias=0.9V, I_tail ~ 311uA. Power = 311uA * 1.8V = 0.56mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The 0.4W reported in the paper is for the entire MUX/DEMUX IC. A single MCML gate consumes a fraction of a milliwatt.

sky130_expected.calculation: gm * R_load. gm ~ 0.9mS, R_load (PMOS in triode) ~ 1.45kOhm. Gain ~ 1.3 V/V or 2.3 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: MCML gates are designed for low voltage swing and high speed, so their voltage gain is typically just enough (>1 V/V) to restore logic levels.

sky130_expected.calculation: 1 / (2*pi*R_load*C_out). Assuming C_out ~ 10fF and R_load = 1.45kOhm, BW ~ 11 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: To support 10 Gb/s operation as reported in the paper, the analog bandwidth of the gate must be at least 5-7 GHz.

propagation_delay.description: Time delay between the differential input crossing 0V and the differential output crossing 0V.

sky130_expected.calculation: Simulated delay for a single stage with 10fF load.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The 2ps reported in the paper might be an unloaded ring oscillator delay. A loaded gate in 130nm typically exhibits 10-20ps delay.
MCML relies on reduced voltage swing (typically 300-500mV) to minimize charging/discharging times for high-speed operation.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC bandwidth and gain, and transient delay and swing of the MCML gate.
step3_testbench.spice:
* MCML Buffer Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N4 N2 N1 N1 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N4 GND VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 N3 N1 N1 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N2 GND N4 N4 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N0 GND N3 N3 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N0 GND VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N1 LABEL_NET_0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}

* Power and Bias Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9

* Input signals (Common mode 1.5V, differential swing 0.4V)
VINP N2 0 DC 1.5 AC 0.5 PULSE(1.3 1.7 0 10p 10p 100p 200p)
VINN N3 0 DC 1.5 AC -0.5 PULSE(1.7 1.3 0 10p 10p 100p 200p)

* Load capacitance (simulating next stage)
C1 N4 0 10f
C2 N0 0 10f

.control
  * 1. DC Operating Point
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * 2. AC Analysis
  ac dec 50 10Meg 100G
  let vout_diff = v(N0) - v(N4)
  let gain_db = 20 * log10(mag(vout_diff))
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10Meg
  let target_gain = dc_gain - 3
  meas ac bw_3db when gain_db = target_gain fall=1

  * 3. Transient Analysis
  tran 1p 600p
  let vout_diff = v(N0) - v(N4)
  let vin_diff = v(N2) - v(N3)
  
  meas tran vout_max max vout_diff
  meas tran vout_min min vout_diff
  let vout_swing = vout_max - vout_min
  print vout_swing
  
  * Delay measurement (crossing 0V)
  meas tran t_delay trig vin_diff val=0 rise=2 targ vout_diff val=0 rise=2
  
  * Rise and Fall times (approximate 20-80% based on expected +/- 0.4V swing)
  meas tran t_rise trig vout_diff val=-0.2 rise=2 targ vout_diff val=0.2 rise=2
  meas tran t_fall trig vout_diff val=0.2 fall=2 targ vout_diff val=-0.2 fall=2
  
  quit
.endc
